args.summary: Acme has 12 active insights across 7 devices: 3 batteries need service, 2 devices critically low on disk space, 1 has prohibited software (uTorrent), 5 have screen_lock compliance drift, and 1 is RAM-constrained.

claims.text: Three devices report battery condition "Service Recommended": acme-macbook-1 (cycle count 1049, since 2026-05-30), acme-thinkpad-8 (cycle count 1157, since 2026-05-23), and acme-dell-9 (cycle count 948, since 2026-05-24).

Two devices have persistently low system volume free space: acme-thinkpad-8 at 2.6% free (26 GB of 1024 GB, low in 25 of 30 snapshots, trend -0.51%/day) and acme-macbook-4 at 2.0% free (10 GB of 512 GB, low in 30 of 30 snapshots, trend -0.20%/day).
Prohibited software uTorrent 3.6 is installed on acme-macbook-2, first seen 2026-05-31.

Five devices show compliance drift on screen_lock (medium severity): acme-macbook-2 failing since 2026-05-22 (22 consecutive fails), acme-thinkpad-8 since 2026-05-30 (14 fails), acme-mac-5 since 2026-06-01 (12 fails), acme-macbook-3 since 2026-06-01 (12 fails), and acme-macbook-4 since 2026-05-28 (16 fails).
acme-dell-9 (M4XVHUV1MEPZ) is RAM-constrained: RAM at or above 95% in 15 of 30 snapshots on a 16 GB device.

caveats: Telemetry covers 2026-05-14 to 2026-06-12 only; nothing outside this window is visible.
RAM constrained finding based on one reading per day; high usage at that moment, not proof of sustained memory pressure.
acme-thinkpad-8 and acme-macbook-4 each have multiple concurrent issues.
